name: PKStruct
description: PKStruct is a PyPI-published Python package providing 20+ production-grade data structure implementations including thread-safe linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, heaps, and graphs. Implements shared exception hierarchy, typing protocols, abstract base classes, and validator modules. Full test suite with 95%+ coverage, CI/CD via GitHub Actions, and pre-commit hook integration. Designed as a reference implementation package for competitive programming and production systems.
achievements: Thread-safe structures with strict type hints
